frontmatter.title: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
frontmatter.description: Advise on content citation strategy for AI answer engines: GEO/AEO, passage answerability, source credibility and per-engine citation measurement. TRIGGER: "get cited by AI search", "appear in AI Overviews", "track AI share of voice", "does llms.txt improve citations?". SKIP: generate/validate llms.txt or llms-full.txt → document-formats; classic/local SEO → venture-business (references/venture-marketing-strategy-local-seo.md); article prose → content-and-marketing-writing; RAG architecture → ai-rag-retrieval; EU TDM rights reservations → eu-ai-act-tdm-opt-out.
whenToUse: How can our pages get cited by AI answer engines?
Compare GEO, AEO and classic SEO for this content.
Design a per-engine citation-rate and AI share-of-voice measurement plan.
Evaluate evidence that llms.txt improves AI citation visibility.
whenNotToUse: generating, validating, or recreating the llms.txt / llms-full.txt file itself (use document-formats; this skill covers llms.txt only as a visibility tactic)

whether an llms.txt / ai.txt / robots.txt signal is a legally valid EU text-and-data-mining opt-out under DSM Art. 4(3) or AI Act Art. 53(1)(c) (use eu-ai-act-tdm-opt-out; llms.txt is a visibility artefact, never a rights reservation)
Classic keyword/on-page SEO without an AI-citation angle
Local SEO, Google Business Profile, GMB optimization
RAG pipeline architecture for internal LLM apps
Marketing compliance or legal review of copy
